commands: set -eu; git fetch --prune origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "3a8b8b2bcc711a498188f8656f34cd1b4b67657a"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo V85_BASELINE_OK

set -eu; JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)"; export JAVA_HOME; PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; export PATH; ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon; test -s app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; shasum -a 256 app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; echo V85_BUILD_OK

set -eu; adb start-server >/dev/null; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')"; test -n "$serial"; model="$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; test "$model" = "SM-S906B"; adb -s "$serial" install -r -d app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb -s "$serial" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 7; pid="$(adb -s "$serial" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r')"; test -n "$pid"; errors="$(adb -s "$serial" logcat -d -v brief -t 1200 | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime: FATAL|io\.blueeye.*FATAL' || true)"; test -z "$errors"; echo V85_DEVICE_SMOKE_OK:$model:pid=$pid
